verdict.rationale: replica-skill is a pack of Claude Code skills (SKILL.md files and slash commands) that run inside a host AI assistant. It is not an app that embeds its own assistant, so asking for a built-in AI assistant inside the product is a category error for this product type. The agentic execution comes from the host platform (Claude Code, or any chat where a SKILL.md is pasted), which earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
